english.title: Contravene an order under section 6 of the Firearms Act 1968 prohibiting removal of ammunition
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) contravened

(A)_[an order made under section 6 of the Firearms Act 1968,]_
(B)_[an order made under section 9 of the Firearms Act 1920,]_
(C)_[a Northern Irish order, being an order made under section 9 of the Firearms Act 1968 as extended to Northern Ireland]_
(D)_[a Northern Irish order, being an order made under section 9 of the Firearms Act 1968 as extended to Northern Ireland or under any enactment of the Parliament of Northern Ireland which repealed and re-enacted that section, prohibiting the removal of firearms or ammunition from Northern Ireland to Great Britain,]_
